result.summary: Implemented Phase 5 UI & UX Polish across the inventory module. Changes: (1) Added current balance badge in movement recording modal. (2) Added 'Set Default Threshold' button + dialog in parts-tab toolbar with summary badge for parts without thresholds. (3) Reviewed alerts-to-PO flow left as-is. (4) Fixed raw color values: text-red-600 to text-destructive, bg-green-50/text-green-700 to Badge variant secondary, updated MOVEMENT_COLORS/PO_STATUS_COLORS with dark-mode-aware colors. (5) Added i18n keys: currentBalance, setDefaultThreshold, defaultThreshold, defaultThresholdDescription, thresholdSet, partsNoThreshold to both mn.json and en.json.
